SOCIAL POST TEMPLATES
=====================

Copy this file and replace every [bracketed] part. Pick 1-2 platforms
your readers use; 2-3 posts per week is enough to start.

NEW BOOK ANNOUNCEMENT
---------------------
My book [Book title] is out now! It's a [genre] book about [one-line
description], written for [audience]. Available at [retailer links].
#[genre] #[topic]

BEHIND THE SCENES
-----------------
Working on [chapter/section] today. This one took [number] tries to
explain in plain English. That's the job. #amwriting #[topic]

NEWSLETTER REMINDER
-------------------
New newsletter went out: [topic]. Join at [landing page link]. No ads,
ever, and you can leave anytime.

EVENT INVITE
------------
I'll be at [library/bookstore] on [date] at [time] talking about [topic].
Free and open to the public. Hope to see you there.

REVIEW THANK-YOU (only where the reviewer posted publicly)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Thank you [Reviewer name] for the kind review of [Book title] — it means
a lot.

PRIVACY NOTES
-------------
- No home address, personal phone, or private email in posts.
- Check photo backgrounds before posting (no home, street, or workplace).
- Never share a reader's name or photo without permission.
- Keep author and personal accounts separate if you want to.

REPURPOSE IDEAS
---------------
One newsletter issue = 3 posts (announcement, tip, reminder).
One press release = 1 announcement post.
One local event = 3 posts (invite, reminder, thank-you after).
